page_title: VAL 1-0 RSO | Valencia v Real Sociedad 19/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+6' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
90+4' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+4' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
89' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
87' Hugo Duro (Valencia) picks up a caution.
87' Jose Gaya (Valencia) is penalised for a foul. Victor Garcia had a clear view and blows his whistle.
83' Javi Guerra (Valencia) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
80' Real Sociedad have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
78' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 7:8.
75' Luis Rioja has picked up an injury and is replaced by Sergi Canos (Valencia).
74' Looks like Luis Rioja (Valencia) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
74' Substitution. Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Brais Mendez walks off.
74' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Orri Oskarsson and he is replaced by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad).
73' The attendance for today's match is 40791.
72' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

72' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Hugo Duro (Valencia) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Alex Remiro pulls off a comfortable save. Good work from Valencia as they win a corner.
70' A pass by Luis Rioja (Valencia) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will take a throw-in.

68' Valencia are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pepelu (Valencia) will replace Andre Almeida.
65' 36:64 – the latest ball possession ratio.
62' Substitution. Sheraldo Becker walks off the pitch and Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.
62' Here is a change. Javi Lopez is going off and Imanol Alguacil gives the last tactical orders to Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad).
59' Substitution. Diego Lopez leaves the pitch and is replaced by Fran Perez (Valencia).
57' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.

55' A lofted cross from Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Real Sociedad.
53' A pass lands at the feet of Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
52' The free kick from long range, taken by Real Sociedad, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

51' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a throw-in.
49' Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Victor Garcia had an easy-decision to make.
49' Real Sociedad fail to score from a corner as Giorgi Mamardashvili (Valencia) leaps to collect the ball.
46' Imanol Alguacil makes a switch. Jon Ander Olasagasti is coming on in place of Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) commits a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for an infringement.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
42' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
41' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
40' Valencia fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.

37' Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Giorgi Mamardashvili. This effort really didn't trouble him.
35' A corner kick by Valencia is thwarted by the well prepared Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad).
32' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
28' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
26' 1 - 0 Hugo Duro (Valencia) receives a great chance inside the box and finds the back of the net with a low drive that goes into the middle of the net.
22' Jose Gaya (Valencia) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Victor Garcia saw the whole situation.
21' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
19' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jose Gaya (Valencia). The ball is behind the touchline and Valencia will take a throw-in.
16' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
14' Hugo Duro (Valencia) meets a cross inside the box, but Alex Remiro wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
13' Valencia work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

10' CHANCE! Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) fires just wide of the left post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Sheraldo Becker. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
8' Real Sociedad are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
5' Diego Lopez (Valencia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
4' Diego Lopez (Valencia) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
2' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Real Sociedad will have the kick-off.
Victor Garcia was nominated as the referee for this game.
